_what: How the Business screen (src/business-screen.mjs) reads the money a person's own payment service took in. One row per read: the Workshop tool that lists money since a moment (`tool_id`, run with the person's own connection), the input that takes that moment in seconds since 1970 (`since_input`), where the answer keeps its entries (`list`) and whether more were left (`more`), how many entries one read holds at most (`at_most`), which field of an entry holds each figure (`fields`: amount, fee and net in the currency's smallest unit, currency, and kind), and which kinds count as a payment or as money returned (`kinds`). Every other kind (a payout, a transfer) moves money the business already has and is not counted. The service's name and whether it is connected come from the tool's own connection. A new payment service is one more row.
